jobs.raw_description: About the company SustainabilityEconomics.ai is a Singapore- and US-based company with a large development center in Bengaluru. The company is building AI agents that are paid on the results they deliver. The first is Clem.ai, an Energy-Mix Agent that plans, contracts and operates the power supply mix for large electricity consumers such as data centers. Its objective is power that is lower in cost than grid supply, at least as reliable, and carbon-free around the clock. The company does not pre-train models. It takes open models and post-trains them on narrow energy tasks where a program can verify the result. Solvers, calculators and simulators perform the arithmetic, and the models are trained to use them correctly. The position We are looking for a Post-Training and Reinforcement Learning Engineer to join the platform team in Bengaluru. The engineer will help train, evaluate and improve the open models behind Clem.ai. This is an early-career position reporting to the Post-Training Lead. The engineer will work alongside senior post-training engineers, applied AI engineers and the company’s energy experts. An independent assurance team approves every model release. Scope of work Prepare, clean and verify training data for tasks such as bill and invoice extraction, contract clause tagging and optimization template completion. Run supervised fine-tuning of open models using low-rank adapters (LoRA) on company GPU infrastructure. Develop reinforcement learning environments and reward functions in which a validator, solver, calculator or simulator scores the model output. Evaluate every model before and after training on the company’s energy-domain benchmark, and report the results accurately. Convert operator corrections and overrides from live operation into new training examples and evaluation cases. Generate and validate synthetic data where real examples are limited. Support the distillation of larger models into smaller, lower-cost models. Maintain reproducible experiments, including configurations, data versions, run logs and written summaries. Use coding agents for first drafts of code, tests and data preparation, and review all output before use. Comply with data governance requirements, including keeping customer data used for per-site tuning within that customer’s sandbox. Required qualifications Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, mathematics or a related discipline. Up to two years of relevant experience, including internships and research projects. Strong proficiency in Python and working knowledge of PyTorch. Demonstrated experience fine-tuning at least one open language model, for example with Hugging Face Transformers and LoRA. Sound understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including data splits, overfitting and evaluation metrics. Working knowledge of reinforcement learning fundamentals, including policies, rewards and environments. Proficiency with Git, Linux and GPU-based training jobs. Rigor in data handling and evaluation, and the ability to report results objectively. Clear written communication in English. Prior experience in the energy sector is not required. Preferred background Practical experience with preference-based or reinforcement learning methods for language models, such as DPO or GRPO-style training. Familiarity with reinforcement learning algorithms such as PPO or SAC, and tools such as Gymnasium. Experience writing reward functions or automated graders. Experience with distillation or synthetic data generation. Experience with structured outputs and tool calling in language models. Exposure to optimization solvers or time-series forecasting. Interest in power markets, renewable energy or data center operations. Open-source contributions, competition results or published research. Personal attributes Leadership skills, including the ability to take ownership of work and guide it to completion. Strong self-motivation and the initiative to work with limited supervision. Eagerness to learn new methods and a new domain quickly. Effective teamwork with engineers, energy experts and the assurance team. Accountability for results and integrity in reporting them. Ability to manage time and deliver to agreed deadlines. Location and application The position is based in Bengaluru. Interested candidates should apply directly through LinkedIn, including their CV and a link to one fine-tuning or reinforcement learning project.

Develop multimodal models for visual perception and scene understanding. Translate natural-language instructions into robotic actions. Explore end-to-end learning for robotic manipulation and navigation. Work on imitation learning and reinforcement learning. Prepare and process robotic datasets, demonstrations, and action trajectories. Train, fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize VLA models. Explore real-time AI inference for robotic applications. Good to Have Familiarity with OpenVLA, RT-2, π0, Octo, or similar foundation models. Knowledge of Vision Transformers (ViT) and CLIP. Experience with Reinforcement Learning and Imitation Learning. Familiarity with ROS 2 and robotic simulation. Knowledge of NVIDIA Isaac Sim and GPU computing. Experience with robotic datasets and simulation-to-real transfer. Eligibility B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech students, fresh graduates, or experienced candidates in AI/ML, Computer Science, Robotics, or related disciplines. Strong fundamentals in AI/ML and deep learning. Academic projects, research work, or personal implementations in AI/ML are preferred. Strong analytical, mathematical, and problem-solving skills. What You'll Work On Core VLA model research and development. Vision-language understanding for robotic systems. Learning-based robotic action generation. Physical AI and embodied intelligence. Training intelligent models using robotic interaction data. Connecting AI models with real-world robotic hardware. We are looking for candidates with strong technical fundamentals, research curiosity, and a genuine interest in building the next generation of intelligent robotic systems. jobs.raw_description: Aleph Technologies is hiring SDE Interns (Full Stack & AI). Location: Pune (Hybrid). Remote within India also considered. Duration: 6 months, starting December (slightly flexible) Type: Paid internship BEFORE YOU APPLY Your resume MUST include: • A link to your GitHub • At least one project you built, with a link (repo, deployed app or demo video). For group projects, say clearly which parts were yours. We look at what you've built before anything else. Applications without GitHub and project links will not be reviewed. ABOUT ALEPH Aleph Technologies builds intelligent systems that solve complex operational challenges in asset-intensive industries, including aviation and logistics. Our product, Aleph Aero, is an AI-powered airport operations platform. It helps large hub airports plan how they run, respond to disruptions in real time, and replace Excel spreadsheets and clunky legacy systems with something planners want to use. We are a small, fast-moving team. Interns work directly with the founding team on production systems, not side projects. THE ROLE Most of the work is on the backend. You'll work on a Python codebase that covers API services, optimisation, simulation, analytics and an AI agent layer, and on the screens airport planners use. This is not a "fetch coffee and watch" internship. You will write code that ships, take part in design discussions, and see your work used in real operational settings. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Build and extend backend services and APIs in Python, guided by senior engineers • Build features in our AI agent layer: LLM tool-calling that reads from and acts on the operational model • Test and evaluate AI behaviour on real scenarios, and find out where it breaks • Turn real operational data (CSV, Excel, JSON) into models that help planners make decisions • Work out what the data can and can't tell us, and write down your assumptions and limits • Build and refine React screens that show your work to planners • Write tests, debug issues, and improve your work based on feedback • Work in short build–deploy–learn cycles through Git, pull requests and async communication MUST HAVES • Solid Python fundamentals • Some backend experience from internships, coursework or personal projects (APIs, data models, services) • Comfort with Git and collaborative workflows • You can debug, not just copy and paste, and you can explain your own code • Comfort working with data in tables, spreadsheets and files • Good written communication (we're async-first and distributed) • Self-starter energy: you don't wait to be told what to do next GREAT TO HAVES • FastAPI, Flask or a similar framework • Any of: SQLAlchemy, Postgres, NetworkX, pytest, async Python • Hands-on work with LLM APIs, function/tool calling or agent frameworks (e.g. LangGraph) • Basic React and TypeScript • Interest in simulation, optimisation, queueing or operations research • Interest in aviation, logistics or operations • Anything you've built end to end and can show We care about what you can build and how you think, not where you went to school. Pre-final and final year students and recent graduates are all welcome. WHY ALEPH • Real impact from day one: your work is used by airport planners at large international hub airports • Direct access to the founding team, with no layers of middle management • Ownership of real work in the product, not a corner of someone else's • Regular mentorship and real feedback • Hard, meaningful problems: modelling, optimisation, AI agents and real operational data • A clear path to full-time: strong performers may convert based on performance, impact and business needs HOW TO APPLY Apply through LinkedIn and answer all the screening questions. We review applications on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will get an email with the next steps. Aleph Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and believe the best teams are built from people with different backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.raw_description: Discover your future at Citi Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. Job Overview You're the brains behind our work. You're ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the boardroom, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it's honing your skills or building your network, we know that success can't come without growth. Our programs equip you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role in your team and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility, and career growth is not a question of if, but when. Citi is looking for Apprentices to join our various divisions. Here at Citi, the Apprenticeship Program is intended to help you build a broad skill set and accelerate your career growth by gaining exposure to numerous day-to-day activities. Your time here will look something like this... The Apprenticeship Program begins in December/January with a short induction, providing apprentices with an overview of Citi, a technology training session, and an introduction to Citi's divisions. As an apprentice you will gain hands on work experience with deliverables and will be expected to add value to their teams during the 12 months. In addition to your daily work, Apprentices can expand their networks here at Citi. We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed . The Apprenticeship Program is a 12-months opportunity in India. The Program will provide Apprentices with on-the-job-training supporting one of Citi's Business Groups. Opportunities are offered in Banking, Markets, Services, Wealth, Operations, Technology, Internal Audit, HR, Services, Risk and Control) Who we think will be a great fit.. . We're looking for motivated individuals who are naturally curious and eager to start their careers in financial services. If you have a knack for problem solving, and you enjoy brainstorming creative ideas, Citi is the right place for you! We value diversity and so do you. We'll also be looking for the following: Enthusiasm to learn about the wide range of roles within assigned business/function Ability to work independently and in a team environment with strong communication skills (both written and verbal) at all organizational levels Possesses resiliency to work in a challenging and changing, high volume environment Ability to think globally, creatively, and innovatively Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Advanced MS Word, Access, Excel, and PowerPoint skills We want to hear from you if... You are pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in any discipline with a graduation date between December 2022 and June 2026 Less than 12 months of prior work experience No ESIC/EFP account Ability to relocate domestically Note: Candidates shortlisted will have to register themselves as an apprentice via the government apprentice portal Apprentice – Role & Responsibilities Business Analytics & Information Management Analyst – C00 About AIM: Analytics and Information Management (AIM) is a global community that is driving data-driven transformation across Citi in multiple functions with the objective of creating actionable intelligence for our business leaders. We are a fast-growing organization working with Citi businesses and functions across the world. Excited to grow your career? We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position, you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply! Our people make all the difference in our success. -------------------------------------------------------------- Role is to solve real business problems through strategic decisioning, analytical problem solving and visualization and dashboarding Responsibilities: Technical Expertise - Expertise in data visualization, cleaning, dashboarding & process automation Analyzes external and internal customer data using Hive, Python, Excel etc. to identify areas of opportunity across bank customer lifecycle. Analytic Project Execution – Own and deliver multiple and complex analytic projects. This would require an understanding of business context, conversion of business problems and implementing such solutions to create economic value. Domain expert – Individuals are expected to be domain expert in their sub field, as well as have a holistic view of other business lines to create better solutions. Key fields of focus are new customer acquisition, existing customer management, customer retention, campaign effectiveness, product development, pricing and payment optimization and digital journey. Good communication skills (both verbal and written) and ability to work with cross-functional partners and team members Adept at managing and manipulating data using Python, Hive/SQL. jobs.raw_description: Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing and protecting in the building sector and manufacturing industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 104 countries, manufactures in 400+ factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers around the world that facilitate the sustainable transformation of the construction and manufacturing industries. With more than 33,000 employees, the company generated annual sales of CHF 11,2 billion in 2023. Sika In India In India, the company started its operations in 1985 and was known as Qualcrete India Limited. In 1987, Qualcrete India Limited forged an alliance with Sika AG, Switzerland and was renamed as Sika Qualcrete Limited. In 2002, Sika AG, Switzerland acquired 100% stake in the company  and since then the company has been rechristened as Sika India Pvt. Ltd., a wholly owned subsidiary of Sika AG. Sika Automotive & Industry Business delivers innovative solutions to the world’s leading manufacturers and service providers in automotive OEM, commercial vehicles, automotive aftermarket, marine vessels, renewable energy, sandwich panels, industrial equipment, HVAC, home and commercial appliances, modular building, facades and fenestration. Sika India services direct customers and distributors and stay close to them via the central sales & marketing office in Pune, and a pan India sales team presence. Job Description Generate qualified project leads by reviewing Biltrax, GlobalData, IRR and other databases. Prepare priced BOQs to support the specification team in submissions. Monitor sales pipeline health and publish dashboards for Target Market Managers. Maintain trackers for key Target Market initiatives and follow up on progress. Support TM Engineering with refurbishment product management tasks and documentation. Keep the TM SharePoint updated with all relevant data, documents, and trackers. Qualifications BE | BTech (Civil | Mechanical | Chemical ) + MBA (Sales and Marketing) Additional Information We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.

This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation.

This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

What You'll Do

  • Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.

  • Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.

  • Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.

  • Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.

  • Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.

  • Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.

  • Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.

  • Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.

  • An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate.

  • High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.

  • Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.

  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.

  • Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.

  • Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.

Why This Role Matters for You

  • Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.

  • Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.

  • From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.

  • Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.

  • San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70â80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.
